visualCharacteristics.purpose: Featured product/news carousel: one slide visible at a time, each a panel with eyebrow, title, description and outlined CTA beside an image or infographic
visualCharacteristics.layout: Slide content left, image right on desktop (stacked on mobile); prev/next arrows on the sides; dot indicators below

contentPattern.structure: cell 1: slide image (picture only); cell 2: optional eyebrow paragraph, title heading, description paragraph, CTA link. Cell order may be swapped; the picture-only cell is treated as the image

usage: Rotating featured product updates or announcements below a hero.
reuseGuidance: Use for side-by-side text and image slides. For full-bleed image slides with overlaid text use carousel.
